page.consentText: I agree to the KYC document storage, OCR processing, booking safety, retention, and no-marketing terms.
page.consentP1: S.M.I.L.E uses your identity data only to verify your account and support booking safety.
page.consentP2: Your uploaded citizen ID front and back images are stored securely for identity verification.
page.consentP3: OCR may verify clear matching documents automatically. Uncertain results are sent to authorized staff for manual review.
page.consentP4: Only authorized staff may review submitted documents, and access is logged for audit purposes.
page.consentP5: KYC data is retained under the active retention policy and is not used for marketing.
